messages:
maria: Quick async standup — model onboarding update

maria: What I did: pushed quantization config for orca-lite-1 to the onboard branch, added a light KV cache warmup in runtime config, and kicked off the eval suite for en/es promptsets. commit: `a1b2c3d`

maria: Blockers: eval-bot flagged a consistent BLEU drop on the spanish_promptset for the v2 quant profile. not sure if it's tokenization or kv state. attaching a short log below.

maria: Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-16T07:12:03Z] eval/spanish_promptset: baseline=0.78 new=0.63 reg= -0.15
[2026-03-16T07:12:03Z] sample mismatch at step 14: expected punctuation preserved, got truncated tail
```

cheng: :eyes: I can take a look today. can you share the exact tokenizer config you're using? maybe the special tokens differ after quantization.

maria: using `tokenizer: sentencepiece_v1`, config at `configs/orca-lite/tokenizer.json` — same as baseline AFAICT. I also saw kv-cache warmup changed ordering (moved warmup before padding trim) — that could affect returned prefixes.

sara: I can try to reproduce locally with the same seeded eval harness. ping me where the synthetic dataset lives.

maria: dataset at `s3://redwood-evals/2026/mini-spanish-pt1` — feel free to pull. note that the failing cases are short dialogs (~3 turns).

eval-bot: FAIL: gating/regressions/spanish_promptset — 12 failing items, 3 high severity. See: https://ci.redwood.internal/evals/3957778888

miguel: Heads-up: if this is kv ordering, we should avoid rolling to dedicated pools until we confirm. I'll add a canary policy flag to the rollout (flag: `canary_kv_v2`) and hold autoscale. :no_entry: 

cheng: quick code-scan: the quant path flips `pad_trim` and `kv_warmup` in `runtime/exec/order.py` — small change but plausible. I'll open a tiny PR and tag for review.

maria: thanks. can you also include a small smoke that runs the spanish_promptset for 50 items after the change?

cheng: yes — PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve/pull/8242 — includes smoke harness and reproducer. cc @dana for rollout policy check.

dana: looks good. when PR is green and smoke passes, we can gate to canary for 2 hrs at 10% traffic. if no regressions, ramp to 50% then 100%. I'll create the rollout rule.

sara: i'll run the local reproducer now and post results in this thread. ETA 30–45m.

maria: appreciate it. for today: I'll triage the failing examples, annotate which are tokenization vs hallucination, and prepare a minimal repro for the quant path.

miguel: also tagging product — we should inform any customers in Dedicated who might be on the older orca-lite variant. I'll draft a short note after we confirm root cause. :memo:

sara: local run done — initial smoke shows same BLEU drop. looks like truncated outputs start after a token id `314`. attaching sample: `"...hasta el punto" -> "...hasta el"`

maria: valuable — that points to padding/trim. I'll revert the order in a branch and run the full eval overnight.

cheng: PR updated with revert option and an env toggle `KV_WARMUP_BEFORE_TRIM=true` so we can experiment without full rollback.

maria: perfect. last note: @cheng @dana if smoke is clean, please ping me before enabling the canary. want to run one more manual seed check.

cheng: will do.

maria: thanks team — short sync. :thumbsup:
